text:
maria: Quick RFC follow-up — proposal for a format-agnostic hotstart gating POC. We're still seeing cold-start spikes when models mix safetensors shards, gzipped tarballs, and inline quant files. Idea: add a lightweight header probe + gating layer that decides one of three warmup strategies: header-only stream, index-first coldmap, or full mmap.

maria: Motivation: many slow paths are caused by eagerly mmap’ing large contiguous files that are actually streamable (safetensors chunks) or compressed. We can improve p90 startup by starting execution as soon as minimal headers and first few chunks are available.

devon: sounds good. how do you detect "streamable" vs "mmap-friendly" without reading whole file?

maria: WeightSource.probe_header(file_path) — read first ~64KB (headers + shard manifest if present). Return tuple: {format, compressed?, chunk_index_table?, byte_ranges_hint}. If chunk_index_table present -> streamable. If compressed flag true -> prefer on-the-fly decompress stream with small buffer.

liam: what about sharded checkpoints where tensor pieces span multiple files? ordering matters for KV cache offsets. Can we hotstart with partial shards?

maria: yes, gating policy can be per-parameter-priority. Default: critical layers (embeddings, ln/gates) hotstart first via incremental fetch; lazy-load attention weights. We maintain a prefix hydration policy plus eviction-safe placeholder tensors (zeros or fp16 air-gap) until real weights arrive.

aisha: telemetry reqs: we should capture probe_time, chosen_strategy, first_nonempty_token_time, and fraction_of_tensors_lazy_loaded. Add these to Redwood Console per-deployment and per-model route.

devon: fallback behavior if probe_header lies (e.g., misreported chunk index)? we need a safe rollback with atomic swap to avoid partial wrong weights loaded in memory.

maria: agreed. Define swap protocol: hydrate into ephemeral arenas per-shard; verify checksums for each tensor (quick checksum on header then full CRC async). Only mark the shard active after all critical tensors pass checksum. If verification fails, fallback to full mmap or alternate variant.

liam: curious about on-disk layout constraints. For stream-first mode, servers need to support partial reads + concurrent read-ahead. This impacts kernel knobs and aio threadpool sizing. We should have a conservative default then tune via Optimize's workload profiler.

aisha: ops note: for Dedicated/Private, we must surface KMS/HSM access timing — decrypting chunk keys can be the slowest part. probe_header should also return encrypted?:true so routing can prefer nodes with local key cache.

maria: rough pseudo:
```py
hdr = WeightSource.probe_header(path)
if hdr.streamable and node.can_stream:
    start_stream_incremental(hdr, priority_map)
elif hdr.index_first:
    mmap_index_first(path)
else:
    fallback_full_mmap(path)
```
Keep it tiny and deterministic.

devon: +1 for canary rollout and metric gates. We should run on smaller models first (<=4GB) then stress test large >100GB bundles.

aisha: I'll add the three telemetry signals to the console onboarding checklist. Also recommend a beta label for models where we enable lazy placeholders.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: created ticket INF-1268 for POC branch + perf harness.

maria: next steps: I'll draft a short RFC with API stubs + safety swap protocol. volunteers for review? devon & liam?

devon: happy to review — can volunteer to write the probe implementation prototype.

liam: can review shard placement and arena safety.

maria: great — I'll ping you both and drop a short design doc in the RFC board by EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:
